note: Curated for beat reactivity and visual density. The original 20 were measured 2026-11-05 in muted headless Chrome (tests/e2e/probe_presets.py: tone mode, full-bundle screen then a 6 s strobe-grade pass); the 15 added 2026-11-08 were ranked by static reactivity from tools/score_presets.mjs (bass/mid/treb + att/beat/q1-q31 taps in frame/pixel/wave/shape equations, audio-driven wave settings) and then deep-probed the same way. 19 of these 35 fill >=90% of the frame. strobe=true is measured, not guessed: luma-grid jumps >=12/255 at >=0.5/s, or >=25/255 peak delta; when quick and deep passes disagree the flag is kept. Reduced-motion users only ever see strobe=false presets. Families steer the mood engine in aura.js: idle=organic/liquid calm, thinking=geometric/fractal structure, approval=cosmic contrast, error=liquid wash under the red tint, streaming=energy.
